spans.s: Chaga is the name of the ‘goat’ in the taittirīya Saṃhitā (v. 6, 22, 1). Cf. aja and chāga.

Chāga, ‘goat,’ is found in the Rigveda, and not rarely later. See aja and chaga.
Foot notes i. 162, 3.
